71 To Jane (‘The keen stars were twinkling’)
S.’s draft of To Jane (‘The keen stars were twinkling’) is in Box 1, on three separate pages, f.
 56r (ll. 1–10), f. 33v (ll. 11–18), and f. 38v reverso (ll. 19–24), which are interspersed among
various passages of the draft of TL. The TL draft is mostly on Italian paper bearing the water-
mark ‘BENEDETTO PARODI’; it is greenish-yellowish paper in sheets measuring approx-
imately 255 x 390 mm, which have been folded once to form a conjugate pair of leaves (i.e.
a booklet of four pages). When placed with the fold to the left from the writer’s perspective,
page 1 of the booklet shows the watermark PARODI correctly (backwards on page 2), while
page 4 shows the BENEDETTO watermark correctly (backwards on page 3). It is almost
certainly the case that S. used this paper between no earlier than the end of May 1822 and
his departure for Livorno on 1 July to meet the newly arrived Leigh Hunt and his family.
